ll binPow(ll a, int b, int p) {
    if (b == 0)
        return 1;
    ll x = binPow(a, b / 2, p);
    x *= x;
    x %= p;
    if (b & 1) {
        x *= a;
        x %= p;
    }
    return x;
}

void solve(int n, const vector<int> &bit, int k, int l) {
    if (k == sz(bit)) {
        ++cnt;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            g[n][i] += rfact[l] * g[n ^ l][i - 1];

            }
        }
        if (cnt >= 8)
            cnt = 0;
        return;
    }
    solve(n, bit, k + 1, l);
    solve(n, bit, k + 1, l ^ (1 << bit[k]));
}
